scenes.hook: A chatbot can explain how to organize files. An agent may actually organize them using tools.
scenes.idea: An agent can plan a step, take an action, inspect the result, and decide what comes next.
scenes.demo: Imagine a helper that reads receipt details, sorts them, and checks whether anything is missing.
scenes.compare: The difference is not a magic personality. It is the combination of a model, tools, and a control loop.
scenes.takeaway: Permissions matter because a mistaken answer and a mistaken action have different consequences.
scenes.close: Which task would you delegate? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for practical tech explained.
